terminal.warning: This is a terminal on the server, with the hub account's permissions.
terminal.warning_detail: Whatever you type runs on the hub's host as the hub's own user, in the profile's folder. Opening and closing a terminal is written to the logs.
terminal.no_pty: This hub has no PTY: commands run and print, but there is no line editing and full-screen programs do not work.
terminal.idle: A terminal nobody types in closes after {minutes} minutes. At most {max} are open at once.
terminal.limit: {max} terminals are open already. Close one first.
terminal.empty_body: A new terminal starts in the {profile} profile's folder.
terminal.disabled: The terminal is not enabled on this hub.
terminal.disabled_body: It is off unless the hub is started with COREHUB_WEB_TERMINAL=1, and even then only the owner sees it.
terminal.gone: This terminal is no longer on the hub.
terminal.open_failed: The hub did not open a terminal. Try again.
